question: A 100-year flood has a 1% chance each year. Chance of at least one in a 30-year mortgage, in whole percent?
move: To find the chance of at least one, work out the chance of none.
trap: Answering 30%, thirty years of 1% added up.
hint: Find the chance of no flood at all in 30 years first.
steps: Chance of no flood in one year: 1 - 0.01 = 0.99.
No flood in 30 years: 0.99 to the power 30 = 0.74.
source: Chow, Maidment and Mays, Applied Hydrology, 1988
reference: Chow, Maidment and Mays, Applied Hydrology, McGraw-Hill, 1988
